# SwayIpcManager

> **File:** `services/compositor/SwayIpcManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Requests to sway that want a reply, through swaymsg: what Quickshell.I3 doesn't cover (its I3.dispatch runs a command with no reply, and it has no window tree, inputs or outputs in full). Only the Sway* services use it; the rest of the shell asks SwayManager (docs/dev/compositor/sway-backend.md). SwayIpcManager.json("get_tree", tree => …) // or null SwayIpcManager.command("[con_id=4] focus", ok => …) SwayIpcManager.dispatch("workspace number 2") // no reply wanted Commands run one at a time, in the order sent, so a chain split over several calls can't overtake itself. Reads run at once.

### Functions

- `json(type, callback)`: Calls back with the reply to a get_* request ("get_tree"), parsed, or null when sway didn't answer
- `command(text, callback)`: Runs sway commands (`text`: one or several, split by ";" or ","), after those sent before, then calls back with whether all of them succeeded.
- `dispatch(text)`: Runs sway commands with no reply wanted: at once (I3.dispatch, no process) when nothing sent before is still running, else after it, so they keep their order with command()'s
